components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single next or committing action in a local context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 16px; color: var(--text-on-accent, #000); background: var(--accent, #FFB900); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #FFB900); border-radius: 2px; font: 700 14px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #CC9500; border-color: #CC9500; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #FFB900); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Neutral Button
components.description: A tactile secondary action on a control-black face.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 11px; color: var(--text, #FFF); background: var(--surface-3, #161616); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #414141); border-radius: 2px; font: 700 14px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { color: #000; background: var(--accent, #FFB900); border-color: var(--accent, #FFB900); } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #FFB900); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive action held in a dark red face until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 11px; color: #FFF; background: #220B0B; border: 1px solid #8F3434; border-radius: 2px; font: 700 14px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #7A1F1F; border-color: #B53C3C; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #FFB900); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: An inset dark field with a strong seam and visible amber focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">EPISODE NAME<input class="ds-field" value="A Different Beast"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: var(--muted, #9A9A9A); font: 700 10px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-field { min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 9px; color: var(--text, #FFF); background: var(--surface-1, #080808); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #414141); border-radius: 2px; font: 14px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #FFB900); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mode Navigation Item
components.description: A quiet icon-and-label mode control with a scarce amber selected state.
components.css: .ds-mode { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 96px; min-height: 62px; padding: 8px 5px; color: var(--muted, #9A9A9A); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; font: 700 10px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mode svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-mode:hover { color: var(--text, #FFF); background: #151515; border-color: var(--line-strong, #414141); } .ds-mode.active { color: var(--accent, #FFB900); background: #15120A; border-color: #4D3900; } .ds-mode:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #FFB900); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ready Status
components.description: A compact operational status using mono type and semantic green.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 9px; color: var(--success, #35C46A); background: var(--surface-1, #080808); border: 1px solid var(--success, #35C46A); border-radius: 2px; font: 700 10px/1.2 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-status span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #35C46A); }

narrative.overview:
pod-god feels like a precise production instrument rather than a generic dashboard. Matte near-black planes join into one workspace; warm white type carries the content; amber, green, and red behave like scarce hardware signals. The hierarchy is confident and spacious around the conversation, then compact and exact inside production controls.

Interaction keeps the creator oriented. Conversation remains the primary canvas, production tools appear contextually, progress is explicit, and advanced infrastructure stays behind disclosure until needed. Motion is brief and functional: it explains a drawer, fold, loading state, or next action, and respects reduced-motion preferences.
keyCharacteristics: Matte, joined planes with quiet seams instead of floating card stacks.
One dominant amber action or current-state signal per context.
Large humanist conversation type paired with compact uppercase mono status labels.
Low-radius tactile controls, native disclosure, and visible keyboard focus.
Green means completed or ready; red means failed or destructive.

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Amber identifies the next action or current state; it does not decorate containers.

rules.name: Semantic Status
rules.body: Green is completion, red is failure or destruction, and neither color substitutes for general emphasis.

rules.name: Two-Voice
rules.body: Human-facing content uses the system sans; operational state uses mono. Do not introduce a decorative third voice.

rules.name: One-Work-Surface
rules.body: On narrow screens, show the selected work surface at full useful width; do not squeeze chat and production side by side.

rules.name: Flat-by-Default
rules.body: If a seam or tonal step can explain the hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: Instrument Edge
rules.body: Low radii make controls feel machined and precise; large soft cards do not belong in this world.

dos: Do let conversation lead and reveal production controls in context.
Do use neutral seams and tonal black steps to organize dense work.
Do reserve amber for the current state, visible focus, and the next meaningful action.
Do preserve semantic status colors, keyboard operation, native disclosure, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep generated changes, progress, and completion states explicit and reviewable.
donts: Don't turn every section into a rounded floating card.
Don't outline every container in amber or use glow as decoration.
Don't invent waveform, progress, collaboration, or publishing data.
Don't hide advanced control permanently; disclose it when relevant.
Don't use motion without a state change to explain.
